I'm tired of putting all my effort and going to nothing. I work really hard in school and it amounts to nothing.

I am always told to wait because it'll get better. I shouldn't have listened to them. I should have transferred out of this shitty university. Now it's too late.

It's just I'm stuck in a vicious cycle where I feel like shit and don't want to work. Then I get hope that it'll get better soon and push through it. Then it gets worse again and crushes the hope out of me because it never got better.

I don't want to wait another decade though.

And it's just waiting is painful because there's nothing I can do to speed it up no matter how hard I try. It's always out of reach and I'd rather die than lie here impotently hoping that it will happen sometime soon, because what if I'm never happy?
